data.body: NOTE (path update 2026-04-29): /dso:implementation-plan SKILL.md consolidated its Scrutiny Gate / Interaction Conflict Gate / Manual Story Tag Guard sections into a single "Pre-flight Tag Guards" section backed by plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/check-tag-guards.sh. Preplanning's own gates were NOT touched and still exist as independent sections. If this story plans to add a new gate to preplanning by mirroring existing structure, the implementation-plan side now uses the consolidated pattern (one section + one checker script) — consider whether to mirror that or stay with preplanning's per-gate structure.
